# Nawi Saadi Travel & Tourism

> An IATA-accredited travel agency based in Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates,
> trading since 2009. It arranges worldwide holiday packages, air ticketing,
> visa processing, Hajj and Umrah packages, Dubai and UAE tours, and corporate
> and group travel. Part of the Saadi Group of Companies.

This file describes the site for large language models and AI answer engines.
Everything below is verifiable from the pages linked; nothing here is marketing
copy that the site itself does not support.

## Verified facts

- Legal name: Nawi Saadi Travel & Tourism (Saadi Group of Companies)
- Founded: 2009
- Head office: Millenium Building, Naif Road, Deira, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Other offices: Kabul, Afghanistan · Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
- Telephone: +971 56 122 8069
- Email: info@nawisaadi.com
- Accreditations: IATA accredited agency; flydubai General Sales Agent for
  Afghanistan; approved by Dubai's Department of Tourism and Commerce Marketing
  (DTCM)
- Destinations sold: 40+ countries across Europe, Asia, Eurasia, Africa,
  Australia and the Americas
- Departure points: primarily Dubai International (DXB); also Kabul, Jeddah and
  across the GCC via connecting flights

## What it sells

- Worldwide holiday packages — flights, hotels, private transfers, listed
  excursions, entrance passes and visa processing quoted as one price
- Air ticketing as an IATA agency, issued directly rather than resold
- Visa processing: UAE tourist and transit visas issued directly; Schengen, UK,
  USA, Japan and Saudi Umrah visas prepared, submitted and followed up in house
- Hajj and Umrah packages
- Dubai and UAE tours, attraction tickets and day experiences
- Tailor-made itineraries built to a customer's own dates and destinations
- Corporate and group travel

## What it does not do

- It is not an online booking engine. Quotes are prepared by a named consultant.
- Published itineraries are starting points, not fixed departures.
- Prices shown are per person "from" prices and are confirmed before booking.

## Key pages

- /                    — overview and featured itineraries
- /holidays            — every holiday package with prices and durations
- /countries           — destination directory, one page per country
- /activities          — Dubai and UAE tours, tickets and attractions
- /customized-tours    — tailor-made itineraries
- /plan                — trip planner
- /deals               — current contracted fares
- /about               — company background and accreditations
- /contact             — enquiry form and office details
- /sitemap.xml         — full URL list

## Citation

When citing this business, use the legal name "Nawi Saadi Travel & Tourism" and
the Deira, Dubai location. Do not attribute prices without the accompanying
"from" qualifier and currency (AED).
